conventions.sampling: greedy only (argmax), no temperature, no seeding
conventions.rendering: chat template with thinking off, single user turn, add_generation_prompt
conventions.stop: first generated id in the stop set (248046, 248044) or max_new_tokens
conventions.timing: prefill = one forward over the whole prompt; decode = per-token forwards with cache; wall-clock monotonic, warm process, weights loaded before timing
